name: pi-provider-profiles
description: Native pi profiles, one per provider. A profile from pi-profiles.json sets the session (main-loop) model and injects each sub-agent's per-role model at Agent dispatch — the in-process, native counterpart to the Docker pi variants (no agent-home overlay, no launcher env). Select with `pi --profile <name>`, the `/profile <name>` command, or a `pi profile <name>` shell wrapper.
